items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: I decided to go back and get my doctorate at the University of Illinois where I studied with Chip McNeil.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, let me give you a little history of me. I got my bachelor’s degree in 1977 in music education. Twenty years later I got my master’s degree in classical flute performance. I studied with the principal in the Indianapolis Symphony here, and then nineteen years later I decided to go back and get my doctorate at the University of Illinois where I studied with Chip McNeil. So my career has been very varied. In between those times I taught for one year at the Indianapolis Public Schools and I said, well…
Wow. You and I — not to get off the track but I noticed you and I share a love of Hubert Laws.
